{
  "manifest_schema": 1,
  "id": "vendor.deploy",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "display_name": "Vendor Deploy",
  "host_api": { "minimum": "0.0.1", "maximum": "99.0.0" },
  "protocol": 1,
  "provider": { "mode": "one-shot", "binaries": { "aarch64-apple-darwin": "bin/deploy" } },
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "vendor.deploy.ship",
      "label": "Ship release",
      "description": "Ship the selected release through the vendor provider",
      "category": "vendor.deploy",
      "contexts": ["dashboard"],
      "arguments": [],
      "timeout_seconds": 60,
      "destructive": false,
      "confirmation": "none",
      "handler": "ship",
      "allowed_outcomes": ["notice"]
    }
  ],
  "panels": [],
  "routes": [],
  "screens": []
}

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
read -r hello
generation=$(printf '%s\n' "$hello" | sed -n 's/.*"generation":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"hello-ack\",\"request_id\":\"p-100001\",\"generation\":$generation,\"payload\":{\"provider_name\":\"scenario-provider\",\"protocol\":1}}"
read -r configure
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"ready\",\"request_id\":\"p-100002\",\"generation\":$generation,\"payload\":{\"capabilities\":[\"actions\"]}}"
read -r invoke
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"progress\",\"request_id\":\"p-100003\",\"generation\":$generation,\"payload\":{\"sequence\":1,\"message\":\"Uploading release\",\"completed\":1,\"total\":2}}"
sleep 2
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"progress\",\"request_id\":\"p-100004\",\"generation\":$generation,\"payload\":{\"sequence\":2,\"message\":\"Publishing release\",\"completed\":2,\"total\":2}}"
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"outcome\",\"request_id\":\"p-100005\",\"generation\":$generation,\"payload\":{\"kind\":\"notice\",\"severity\":\"info\",\"message\":\"Release shipped\"}}"
read -r shutdown
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"shutdown-ack\",\"request_id\":\"p-100006\",\"generation\":$generation,\"payload\":{}}"
